text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/resend_failed_sms.py (P1): it loads the outbox via sent_messages() and the gateway map via delivery_status(), identifies messages whose status is 'failed' (skipping 'delivered' and missing entries), and for each failed message checks whether an identical resend (same household_id, template_id and params, with a greater id) already exists — skipping such households so nobody is texted twice. Otherwise it calls queue_sms(original.household_id, original.template_id, original.params, now=None) to re-queue the same text, and prints a summary of skipped vs re-sent. Ran it once (P2): all 9 failed messages (SMS-00002, 05, 07, 08, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15) were detected as already re-sent by SMS-00016..SMS-00024, so the script queued nothing new — 9 skipped, 0 re-sent — and no delivered household was texted.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
reasoning: All 9 failed messages were already re-sent; nothing new queued. Done.
